$description: Per-family WCAG 2.x contrast targets — the recorded PROPOSAL (not designer-decided); designers confirm or adjust by editing this file. Each targeted slot is measured against its `against` token in the same mode. Untargeted slots (backgrounds, highlight, border-light/border-dark, brand, the interaction fills) are surfaces or decorative variants by design: border-light (light 2.17:1) and border-dark (dark 1.45:1) sit below 3:1 today, so only the main border slot carries the UI target — that calibration keeps the known failure set at exactly the three recorded dark values.
